description: A forest with rocks on rolling terrain, ready for a game engine. The ground is a heightfield of 257 × 257 samples over the chosen size: broad rolling hills with ridged flanks, scaled to exactly 0..relief. Its paint layers are weights that add up to 1: rock on the steepest ground (8° and more above max_slope), forest floor under the forest (gentle ground, broken into clearings by a noise that tree_density thresholds) and grass on the rest. Trees (pine, fir and oak, from topotopo/nature/tree_lowpoly; oaks lower down, conifers higher up) are scattered on the forest at an even spacing, upright with a random heading and size; rocks (three shapes of topotopo/nature/rock) gather in clusters on the slopes from just below max_slope to the steepest, leaning with the ground. Both are packed instances placed on the ground as an engine's landscape triangulates it (heightfield_scatter sample unreal_triangles), whole within the terrain. Asserts check that no tree stands steeper than max_slope, that every instance sits on the ground (within 1 cm of the terrain's surface under it) and that every instance's bounds stay within the terrain. Node showcase (not an output) draws the three together, the ground coloured by its paint layers.

seed.label: seed
seed.desc: changes the hills and the layout, not the look

relief.label: relief
relief.desc: height of the hills, from the lowest ground to the highest (m)

tree_density.label: tree density
tree_density.desc: how full the forest is: the share of the gentle ground under trees

rock_density.label: rock density
rock_density.desc: how many rocks lie on the slopes

max_slope.label: max slope
max_slope.desc: steeper ground than this stays bare of trees (degrees)

params.expression: const t = 1.05 - 1.1 * tree_density; return mask * smoothstep(t - 0.05, t + 0.05, cover) * (1 - rock);

tree_copies.note: variants by name: each variant's prims carry the variant's name, so the exports name the meshes pine, fir and oak

rock_copies.note: variants by name: each variant's prims carry the variant's name, so the exports name the meshes boulder, slab and stone

tree_gap.note: no assert compares points with a terrain surface, so the ground under each instance is read from the grid here

params.names: ground_gap reach mask height variant yaw

rock_gap.note: no assert compares points with a terrain surface, so the ground under each instance is read from the grid here

terrain.label: Terrain
terrain.description: The ground: a heightfield from 0 to relief with the paint layers grass, forest_floor and rock (weights that add up to 1).

trees.label: Trees

rocks.label: Rocks
